title: Tapes and photographs to send to Rutgers
summary: Fields promises tapes, pictures and booking records for the project, and Love says eight and a half hours were recorded.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Anything else you'd like to talk about?

What I will do, as I said, I don't have them now, but Ron mentioned several numbers that are not in the In The Mood area, and what I'm going to do is I'm going to make them and so there won't be any confusion

of what they belong with, send them to you and let him know that that belongs there. He made mention that he had no tapes or anything, and I think when you send him all of these pictures, he's going to be really surprised.
I'll also send those that I had, maybe he'll want to know about the bookings that I had made of Ann Bowls (phonetic spelling), and Ernie Fields, Jr., which at that time I was booking.
Well, we have covered a lot, we have approximately eight and a half hours of invaluable--
Was there a time that we made mention--I made some notes, I'd just like to--
